subject: POC momentum plan and gating cadence
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC momentum plan and gating cadence

Hi Sanjay — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery so we can keep momentum.

Summary of what we heard (high level):
- Primary use case: customer support triage and answer generation for billing queries.
- Success metrics you care about: 1) 90% intent classification accuracy on core billing intents, 2) <1.5s p95 generation latency for routing scenarios, 3) 15% reduction in manual triage time during the trial.
- Constraints: redacted PII in flight, SOC 2 evidence required for procurement, limited access to staging DB for first two weeks.

Proposed POC plan (6-week, lightweight):
1) Week 0 (prep): security intake + dataset access + kickoff.
2) Weeks 1–4: baseline ingest, model on-boarding, evaluation against your evaluation set; weekly readouts.
3) Week 5: resilience & latency tuning (quantization / batching exploration).
4) Week 6: final readout, handoff doc, runbook and recommendations.

Requested confirmations from you:
- Do the success metrics above align? Please suggest edits if needed.
- Stakeholders to include at kickoff (product, security, legal).
- Preferred kickoff week (we have availability week of May 24).

We attached a short checklist (POC-checklist.xlsx) that calls out required access, sample formats, and an initial timeline. If you confirm the metrics & kickoff window, I’ll loop in engineering owners and publish a milestone calendar.

Thanks — excited to get this running.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0182
POC checklist attached: POC-checklist.xlsx
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finlytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal <legal@finlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC momentum plan and gating cadence

Tessa — thanks for the clear recap. This looks close to what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

Priorities & constraints:
- Top priority is intent classification accuracy for billing intents (we'll provide a 4k-example labeled set).
- Latency target is firm for customer-facing routing flows; offline batch generation can be higher latency.
- Security: SOC2 and encryption-in-transit + at-rest are mandatory. Our legal team will need the standard evidence pack before we sign any MSA.

Kickoff & stakeholders:
- Kickoff week of May 24 works for us; prefer May 24 or May 25 mornings.
- Participants: myself (product), Rhea Patel (engineering lead) <rhea.patel@finlytics.com>, and Legal on standby.

Two asks now: 
1) Can you share SOC2 artifact location or a short security brief?
2) Ballpark pricing for a 6-week POC (hosted, and an option for dedicated capacity if we need predictable throughput).

If you can get those over, we'll confirm kickoff attendees and send a calendar hold.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Product, FinLytics
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: POC momentum plan and gating cadence

All — forwarding Sanjay's reply and the checklist. Sanjay confirmed week of May 24 (prefers 24/25 mornings) and called out SOC2 artifacts and pricing.

Can we assign owners and commitments? Proposed split below — please confirm or propose alternatives: 
- Marissa Cole (CS) — overall POC owner, weekly readouts, acceptance criteria validation with customer.
- Jonas Weber (Infra) — validate infra plan, advise on Dedicated vs. Hosted for latency SLOs, provide initial cost estimate for Dedicated pool.
- Camila Reyes (SE) — lead technical kickoff, dataset onboarding guidance, sample prompts, and evaluation harness setup.

Immediate asks: 
- Jonas: can you draft a 4-line infra recommendation (hosted vs dedicated) and an estimated throughput/cost note by EOD Thursday?
- Marissa: confirm availability to run weekly readouts (Fridays preferred) and own acceptance criteria tracking.
- Camila: please review the attached technical runbook template and flag any missing items for dataset or access (attached: technical-runbook-template.md).

Also: Sanjay asked for SOC2 evidence. I can share our security brief and SOC2 artifact link — would like someone from security to vet before we send. If Legal wants anything specific, loop them in.

I'll prepare a milestone calendar once owners confirm.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@finlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC momentum plan and gating cadence — owners & schedule

Hi team / Sanjay — thanks for the patience. Confirming owners and a proposed milestone schedule below. Linking the sprint plan and a DocuSign link for a short POC addendum (we typically do a simple SOW for reserved capacity requests).

Owners (confirmed):
- Marissa Cole: POC lead / weekly readouts / acceptance tracking.
- Jonas Weber: infra lead — Dedicated recommendation, capacity sizing, monitoring hooks.
- Camila Reyes: SE lead — onboarding, eval harness, prompt templates.
- Tessa Morgan: commercial lead / cadence & stakeholder coordination.

Proposed milestone calendar (final version attached: POC-sprint-plan.pdf):
- Kickoff: Tue, May 24, 2027 @ 10:00 AM PT (Zoom link: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/5xKj) — agenda: scope, data access, success gates, responsibilities.
- Weekly check-ins: Fridays 9:00 AM PT (standing 45m) — short readouts, blockers, next steps.
- Midpoint readout: Fri, June 14, 2027 — preliminary metrics and any tuning needs.
- Final readout: Wed, June 30, 2027 — results vs acceptance criteria, recommendation to proceed to pilot/prod.

Security & legal: Tessa — we'll share the SOC2 brief (redwood-security-brief.pdf) to Sanjay and Legal once Marissa confirms and security gives the green light.

Pricing note (ballpark):
- Hosted POC option: consumption-based; estimate ~$3k–5k for run of this size (depends on token usage and eval workload).
- Dedicated POC option: short-term reserved pool estimate included in POC-sprint-plan.pdf; requires a simple addendum (DocuSign link above).

Next steps:
1) Tessa to send calendar invites for kickoff & weekly check-ins.
2) Marissa to confirm Friday check-in cadence and supply acceptance criteria template.
3) Camila to start dataset onboarding doc and share access checklist.
4) Tessa to coordinate security artifact share with Sanjay's legal.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

Jonas Weber
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: POC-sprint-plan.pdf
